The question: what portion of the adjusted consolidated cash flow is related to tower cash flow? That would be tower cash flow (twelve months) divided by adjusted consolidated cash flow. Tower cash flow for twelve months is 524,804 (absolute value). Adjusted consolidated cash flow is 531,822. So portion = 524,804 / 531,822. Compute. 524804/531822 ≈ 0.9868. So about 98.68%.
